decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures such as Troll of Khazad-dûm and Murktide Regent using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bring them back to the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruption spells like Daze and Thoughtseize to control the game and protect the combo. Additionally, cards like Brazen Borrower and Archon of Cruelty provide additional threats and flexibility to navigate different game states. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan.

This deck focuses on using Show and Tell to cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play quickly. It also utilizes cards like Mind Over Matter and Lórien Revealed to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Chalice of the Void and Force of Will provide additional protection and disruption, while Stock Up and Intuition help to find key cards in the deck. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Emrakul, then using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield. It also includes disruption spells like Unmask and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect your combo. The goal is to rapidly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with massive threats before they can effectively respond, ultimately controlling the game through powerful reanimation effects.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through countering opponent's spells, disrupting their strategy, and utilizing cards like Stifle and Dress Down to neutralize threats. It also aims to efficiently bring out Phyrexian Dreadnought and combine it with instant speed removal like Swords to Plowshares to cheat a powerful creature onto the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Curie, Emergent Intelligence provide card advantage and selection, ensuring the player maintains control of the game and comes out on top.

This Dragon Stompy deck aims to aggressively lock down opponents with cards like Chalice of the Void, Magus of the Moon, and Blood Moon while ramping up quickly with mana acceleration from Chrome Mox, Simian Spirit Guide, and Ancient Tomb. The deck utilizes powerful red spells like Fury, Sundering Eruption, and Shatterskull Smashing to deal massive damage and control the board. Broadside Bombardiers and Pyrogoyf provide additional threats, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can create advantageous situations. The One Ring serves as a versatile and powerful equipment to further enhance the deck's aggro strategy.

This deck focuses on using the combo of Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Nomads en-Kor to draw the entire deck and win the game in one turn. By using Green Sun's Zenith and various tutors, the deck is designed to quickly assemble the combo pieces while also having interaction and protection in the form of Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares. Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo and disrupt opponents, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help find the combo pieces more consistently. The deck is a well-rounded combo deck that aims to win the game quickly and efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to use the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill your opponent's entire library, while also utilizing cards like Goblin Engineer and Pyrogoyf to support the combo and control the board. Additionally, the deck includes various red spells and creatures to further enhance its strategy and disrupt your opponent's plans. Overall, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm opponents with its powerful synergy and aggressive plays.

The main concept of the following deck is to quickly generate mana using cards like Cabal Ritual and Simian Spirit Guide, while also utilizing cards like Necrodominance and Borne Upon a Wind to bring out powerful creatures like Chancellor of the Annex. The deck also features cards like Pact of Negation to protect key combo pieces and cards like Dark Ritual to further accelerate the deck's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to assemble a powerful combo and win the game in a fast and efficient manner.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently combo off by milling the entire library using cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer, then winning the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck includes multiple ways to accelerate mana generation and combo pieces, with protection in the form of Pact of Negation and Chancellor of the Annex. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces and disrupt opponents' strategies with cards like Cabal Therapy and Poxwalkers, ultimately leading to a decisive win through a powerful combo sequence.

The main concept of this Canadian Threshold deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent using aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by powerful disruption spells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Wasteland and Lightning Bolt while also maintaining card advantage through cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. Murktide Regent and Questing Druid provide additional threats that can quickly close out the game. The deck's synergy between aggression and disruption allows it to stay ahead and overwhelm the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly get powerful creatures into play by utilizing the Reanimate combo. With cards like Entomb, Animate Dead, and Reanimate, the deck aims to cheat out high-impact creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck includes card draw and filtering options like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Preordain to ensure card advantage and consistency in executing the combo.

This deck focuses on playing powerful Eldrazi creatures quickly and efficiently, using cards like Eldrazi Temple, Eye of Ugin, and Cavern of Souls to ramp and cast them. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Glaring Fleshraker while disrupting their strategies with cards like Chalice of the Void and Kozilek's Command. The deck also includes utility lands like Wasteland and Blast Zone to deal with problematic threats from the opponent. Overall, this deck aims to apply early pressure and control the game with its Eldrazi creatures.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of powerful creatures and equipment to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive attacks. By using cards like Stoneforge Mystic to search for key equipment pieces, Recruiter of the Guard to tutor for crucial creatures, and Skyclave Apparition to deal with threats on the opponent's side, it aims to control the board and maintain a strong board presence. With a mix of removal spells, disruptive creatures, and powerful threats, the deck aims to outpace and overwhelm the opponent in the Legacy format.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get powerful creatures into the graveyard using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then bring them back to the battlefield using Reanimate and Animate Dead. This allows the player to cheat out high-cost creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty early in the game, overwhelming opponents with powerful threats. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its combo pieces and counter opposing threats. With the right combination of cards, this deck can create explosive plays and win games in a few turns.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly ramp up mana and disrupt the opponent's game plan using disruptive artifacts like Trinisphere and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck aims to lock down the opponent's resources while playing powerful dragon creatures like Fury and Pyrogoyf to close out the game quickly. The inclusion of cards like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox enables explosive starts, and cards like Shatterskull Smashing provide additional reach and removal options. Overall, the deck focuses on aggressive plays and resource denial to overwhelm the opponent.

The key concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's plays while gradually building up card advantage and board presence. It aims to outvalue the opponent by using powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Tamiyo, along with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By controlling the game tempo and resource management, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage.
